descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S07 Each server-side PHI store is covered by the at-rest evidence

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 Convex at-rest encryption is confirmed active on the account through a settings check. At-rest encryption is confirmed active. (UAT OAT-02; TFA-92568 AC 4; TFA-92568 Eng 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given The at-rest evidence from S02, and the list of places that hold PHI on the server side: Convex tables (patients and residents, notes, transcripts, tasks, handoffs, aiCallLog, audit), Convex backups and snapshot exports, Convex function logs, every sink on the Convex deployment's Integrations page (log streams, excepti …

When Match each store to the evidence. Tim reads, on the UAT AWS account and region, whether Bedrock model-invocation logging is on and whether text data delivery is on, and opens the Convex deployment's Integrations page.

Then Every PHI-holding store is covered by confirmed at-rest encryption, backups included (OAT-04 'encrypted backups'). Bedrock text delivery is expected off (the infra comment: 'text delivery must remain off: prompts contain chart data'). …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U3. A PHI-holding store that the evidence does not cover = Fail; this includes the Bedrock log bucket when text delivery is on and any enabled Convex integration sink. Whether backups, logs and integration sinks are in scope is Q4.

Where it ran: dev; test method CONFIG · Config check; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: CONFIG · Config check; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
